model_selection.rule: lowest validation expected cost per message = 5 x 0.05 x (1 - recall) + 1 x 0.95 x false-alarm rate (5% scam rate ASSUMED; cost ratio 5:1 as in v1)
model_selection.selection_training: UCI train + English scams 2015-2020 (+ India train group half A1) (+ synthetic train half)
model_selection.validation: English scams dated 2021 (recall) + India train group half A2 (false alarms); no 2022+ data, no MOZ, no India test groups
model_selection.comparison_rows: fa_budget_10pct_on_india_a1 (threshold set on India A1 scores for models not trained on India) and the two link rules are scored for comparison only; the shipped choice is made among cost_5to1_oof and fa_budget_10pct_oof rows

triage.status: post-hoc design (V2 consensus), evaluated; post-deadline v2 (Nov 18)

definition.RED: Likely scam - do not tap, do not reply = model flags AND the text has a link or phone number
definition.YELLOW: Ask family before replying = model flags with no link/phone, OR a rule fires (asks for a code/PIN/password; 'hi mum / new number / wrong number' opener)
definition.GREEN: No warning signs found = otherwise; never worded as 'safe'

assumed_5pct_scam_rate.assumption: 5% of incoming texts are scams (ASSUMED, not measured); recall = triage share warned (RED or YELLOW) on 2022-24 scams; false-alarm rate = share warned on the named legit set

undated_near_copy_check.rule: char_wb 3-5 TF-IDF max cosine to any English training scam dated <= 2021, near-copy if > 0.8
undated_near_copy_check.note: the undated set is not cluster-safe; only the 2022-24 cluster-safe set is

failure_examples.rule: missed scams: real 2022-24 reports left GREEN; for each of the 5 scam types with the most GREEN misses, the shortest text of at least 40 characters. False alarms: the 2 shortest held-out synthetic legit texts that got RED or YELLOW.

threshold_discipline.rule: each threshold is chosen on out-of-fold predictions of the model's own training data (5 folds; group-aware when India rows are in training), minimising 5 x missed scams + 1 x false alarms; frozen before any 2022+ or held-out evaluation
threshold_discipline.alternative_rule: false-alarm budget: lowest threshold with <= 10% out-of-fold false alarms on India-train legit
